title: Hananiah the False Prophet

questions.question: In that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year of Zedekiah, who prophesied falsely to Jeremiah in the house of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:1 (ESV): "Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord,"

questions.question: What did Hananiah say the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, had broken?
options: The yoke of the king of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: The yoke of the king of Babylon
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:2 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon."

questions.question: How long did Hananiah say it would be before all the vessels of the Lord's house were brought back to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:3 (ESV): "Within two years I will bring back to this place all the vessels of the Lord's house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away"

questions.question: Who else did Hananiah say would be brought back to Jerusalem from exile in Babylon?
options: Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) king of Judah, and all the exiles
questions.correctAnswer: Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) king of Judah, and all the exiles
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:4 (ESV): "I will also bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon, declares the Lord,"

questions.question: What did Jeremiah reply to Hananiah's prophecy in the presence of the priests and the people?
options: "You are a false prophet, and shall die!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:6 (ESV): "and the prophet Jeremiah said, 'Amen! May the Lord do so; may the Lord make the words that you have prophesied come true,'"

questions.question: Jeremiah reminded Hananiah that the prophets of old prophesied what against many countries and great kingdoms?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:8 (ESV): "The prophets who preceded you and me from ancient times prophesied war, famine, and pestilence against many countries and great kingdoms."

questions.question: "As for the prophet who prophesies... , when the word of that prophet comes to pass, then it will be known that the Lord has truly sent the prophet."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:9 (ESV): "As for the prophet who prophesies peace, when the word of that prophet comes to pass, then it will be known that the Lord has truly sent the prophet."

questions.question: What physical action did Hananiah the prophet take against Jeremiah in front of the people?
options: He took the yoke-bars from Jeremiah's neck and broke them
He struck Jeremiah on the cheek
He spat on the ground before him
questions.correctAnswer: He took the yoke-bars from Jeremiah's neck and broke them
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:10 (ESV): "Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke-bars from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke them."

questions.question: What did Hananiah declare while doing this physical action?
options: "Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar... within two years."
"So shall the strength of Babylon be shattered."
"This is what the Lord does to false prophets."
"Let the chains of our oppression be broken!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar... within two years."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:11 (ESV): "And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all the nations within two years.'"

questions.question: What did Jeremiah do after Hananiah broke his wooden yoke?
options: He cried to the Lord in anger
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:11 (ESV): "But Jeremiah the prophet went his way."

questions.question: After Hananiah broke the wooden yoke, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah. What was Jeremiah instructed to tell Hananiah?
options: You have broken wooden bars, but you have made in their place bars of iron.
You have spoken falsely, and the true yoke is gold.
The Lord has rejected you and your father's house.
Babylon will shatter you like you shattered the wood.
questions.correctAnswer: You have broken wooden bars, but you have made in their place bars of iron.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:13 (ESV): "Go, tell Hananiah, 'Thus says the Lord: You have broken wooden bars, but you have made in their place bars of iron.'"

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put upon the neck of all these nations an... yoke to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they shall serve him..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:14 (ESV): "I have put upon the neck of all these nations an iron yoke to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,"

questions.question: Jeremiah said to Hananiah: "Listen, Hananiah, the Lord has not... you, and you have made this people trust in a... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:15 (ESV): "Listen, Hananiah, the Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie."

questions.question: "Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Behold, I will remove you from the face of the earth. This year you shall... , because you have uttered rebellion against the Lord.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:16 (ESV): "This year you shall die, because you have uttered rebellion against the Lord."

questions.question: In which month of that same year did Hananiah the prophet die?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 28:17 (ESV): "In that same year, in the seventh month, the prophet Hananiah died."

key_verse_text: And Jeremiah the prophet said to the prophet Hananiah, "Listen, Hananiah, the Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie. Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Behold, I will remove you from the face of the earth. This year you shall die, because you have uttered rebellion against the Lord.'"
